svg.title: NEON SPORE · BREAKS
svg.text: generated by `bun run breaks` from shatter.ts — every row is one tuning, every column one moment

g.text: six wedges, one ring — the coarsest break there is, and the one that still reads at 26 px
the same body cut again at half its reach: a shattered core and slabs of skin off the rim
the origin pushed down where the shot came from — the near pieces leave hardest
the contour most likely to defeat a ray cast, cut anyway — every club goes with a piece
sixteen wedges, twice over: what over-cutting looks like, kept on the sheet as the wrong end
